name: Forme SEO AI Agent
author: calvinseng90

sections.description:
Forme SEO AI Agent connects your WordPress site to the Forme SEO SaaS API so site owners can run SEO audits, generate content plans, review article topics, and track monthly usage from WP Admin.

The plugin includes:

  • SEO health dashboard
  • Website audit workflow
  • Content planner
  • Article topic workflow
  • Reports dashboard
  • Usage tracking
  • Stripe Checkout upgrade flow
  • Stripe Billing Portal subscription management
  • Google Search Console connection support

External Service Disclosure

This plugin connects to the Forme SEO SaaS API hosted at:

https://claude.seo.calvinseng.com

This external service is required for AI-powered SEO analysis, content planning, article topic generation, subscription billing, and account usage tracking.

Data sent to the service may include:

  • Website URLs
  • SEO audit requests
  • SEO metadata
  • Content planning prompts
  • Generated article topics
  • Google Search Console property selections, if connected
  • Billing-related customer identifiers handled through Stripe

The service offers both free and paid plans. Payment details are processed by Stripe and are not stored in WordPress.

Privacy

Forme SEO AI Agent sends requests to an external API service to process SEO audits, content plans, usage data, and optional Google Search Console data.

Payment information is handled by Stripe Checkout and Stripe Billing Portal. This plugin does not store credit card details in WordPress.

Site owners are responsible for informing their users about any external service connections and data processing that may occur.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/forme-seo-ai-agent/, or install the plugin zip from WordPress admin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to Forme SEO in the WordPress admin sidebar.
  4. Create a free account and API key or enter an existing API key in Settings.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require an external account?

Yes. The plugin connects to the Forme SEO SaaS API. A free account and API key can be created from the plugin dashboard.

Is payment data stored in WordPress?

No. Payments and subscription management are handled by Stripe Checkout and Stripe Billing Portal.

Can I use the plugin for free?

Yes. A free plan is available with limited monthly usage.

What happens when I upgrade?

The plugin redirects to Stripe Checkout. After payment, subscription status and usage limits are synced through the Forme SEO API.

How do I cancel or downgrade?

Use the Manage Subscription button in the plugin. Cancellation and subscription management happen inside Stripe Billing Portal.
